**Haiti: how applications changed.** The extract records 732,479 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 131,818 in 2023, compared with 93,343 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 130% higher than in 2019 (40,647). Applications in 2025 were 18% higher than in 2024 (78,809). In 2025, the leading destinations were United States (52,130; 56%), Canada (18,231; 20%), France (13,306; 14%). United States received 56% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 12% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 83%, across 22,580 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 58% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 10.1 percentage points higher than in 2024 (73%).
